This petition is filed by the husband and in-laws seeking quashing of the proceedings pending in C.C.No.37159/2022 arising out of Crime No.154/2022 registered by Vidyaranyapura police station Mr Vinay Kumar Honnur vs The State Of Karnataka on 26 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195438085/

sentences.text: 2. Today, the husband, mother-in-law, father-in-law, and respondent No.2/wife are present before this Court.
A joint affidavit has been filed indicating that the parties have amicably settled the dispute before the Family Court, where the marriage between the husband and wife has been dissolved.
3. Respondent No.2 is present before this Court and, on being queried, she confirms that the marriage with accused No.1/husband now stands dissolved.
She further submits that, in view of the settlement before the Family Court, she intends to withdraw all allegations and has no objection to quashing the present proceedings.
NC: 2025:KHC:39180 HC-KAR 4.

Since the marital discord has been put to rest by dissolution of marriage and as respondent No.2 has expressly consented to quashing the proceedings, this Court finds it a fit case to exercise its inherent jurisdiction under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.

Though the offence under Section 498A IPC is not ordinarily compoundable, in view of the settlement and dissolution of marriage, this Court deems it just and proper to invoke its inherent powers to secure the ends of justice and to prevent abuse of process of law.

5. Accordingly, for the foregoing reasons, the following order is passed:
ORDER i.

The criminal petition is hereby allowed; ii. The proceedings in C.C.No.37159/2022 arising out of Crime No.154/2022 registered by Vidyaranyapura Police Station and pending on the file of the XLI Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bangalore, for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 498A read with Section 34 IPC and Sections 3 and 4 NC: 2025:KHC:39180 HC-KAR of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, in so far as the petitioners are concerned, stand quashed.
Sd/-
(SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM) JUDGE HDK CT: BHK Mr Vinay Kumar Honnur vs The State Of Karnataka on 26 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195438085/
